entry.title: Market brief — 13 November 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Friday 13 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,144.30 (-155.05, -0.61%) and the Sensex at 81,592.45 (-318.56, -0.39%), with the rupee about 20 paise weaker at 94.24 per dollar. IBJA's morning benchmark put 24K gold at Rs 1,35,884 per 10 g (-2,410) and 999 silver at Rs 1,77,500 per kg (-4,499).
